title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - User
description: Generic User structure used to define commonalities between sub concepts of PartyUser and Financial User. (TM Forum TMF914 IoT Service Management Component Suite 4.0.0, Swagger definition User; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:User:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'User'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF914_IoTServiceComponentSuite/blob/d8feb27048f25dc2a011d4f2e3422410452ba1d0/TMF914-IotService-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/User/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:User:<tmfId>. unique identifier

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF914_IoTServiceComponentSuite/blob/d8feb27048f25dc2a011d4f2e3422410452ba1d0/TMF914-IotService-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/User/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF914_IoTServiceComponentSuite/blob/d8feb27048f25dc2a011d4f2e3422410452ba1d0/TMF914-IotService-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/User/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF914_IoTServiceComponentSuite/blob/d8feb27048f25dc2a011d4f2e3422410452ba1d0/TMF914-IotService-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/User/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'User' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name
